row.name: Streamly
row.description: Streamly is a dynamic video platform for fans of animation, gaming, and creative content. Inspired by Bilibili, it offers a smooth viewing experience, interactive live streaming, and vibrant communities, all in a sleek, customizable Flutter-based app.
